    if len(text) <= width:

```python
import re

def slugify(text):
    """Convert text to lowercase, replace spaces with dashes, and remove punctuation."""
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text)
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '-', text).strip('-')
```
